baseline.actual: Static P1 findings exist in diagnostic session answer DELETE policy and post-finalization answer projection; clinical gates remain open.

criteria.conditions: A missing live boundary is not a pass; production and clinical claims require their own authority and evidence.
criteria.evidence_method: Independent critique plus current focused, integration, security, migration, and regression evidence against the exact integrated artifact.
criteria.target: No unresolved P0/P1 security, authorization, data-integrity, or clinical-publication defect remains in the release scope.
criteria.validity_notes: A green unit suite cannot close an untested RLS or clinical boundary.

baseline.actual: Prior current baseline reported 84.31% statements and 80.13% branches; decision completeness for new gaps is not yet proven.

criteria.conditions: Coverage must exercise the relevant boundary and cannot replace live or human gates.
criteria.evidence_method: Current coverage report, invariant decision matrix, mutation/negative tests where justified, and regression suite.
criteria.source: AGENTS.md quality requirements and AAA plan
criteria.target: Global coverage remains at least 80 percent and critical invariants have complete decision coverage.
criteria.validity_notes: A percentage without critical-case coverage is insufficient.

baseline.actual: Current diagnostic-to-assignment journey is not proven through the real boundary.

criteria.conditions: Synthetic HTTP interception or pre-provisioned assignment does not satisfy the diagnostic-to-assignment criterion.
criteria.evidence_method: Fresh E2E with real persistence, separate administrative oracle, cleanup proof, request/response and state inspection.
criteria.source: Current user request and AAA plan
criteria.target: Critical participant journeys work through the correct browser/web/API/PostgreSQL/RLS boundary where applicable.
criteria.validity_notes: The boundary must include authorization and persistence, not only route rendering.

baseline.actual: Existing public-boundary and exposure checks passed locally; new visual assets are decorative only.

criteria.conditions: The claim is limited to checked artifacts and must be re-run after each boundary change.
criteria.evidence_method: Exposure scanner, DTO/schema inspection, negative tests, browser/network inspection, and redacted log inspection.
criteria.target: No source, answer key, internal field, participant data, secret, or clinical trace crosses the public participant boundary.
criteria.validity_notes: Static allowlists do not prove every runtime path.

baseline.actual: A visual lane is active; its final critic and matrix are not yet integrated.

criteria.conditions: Source/CSS review alone cannot close visual acceptance.
criteria.evidence_method: Fresh rendered route matrix at 1440, 768, and 390 pixels; axe, keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, console/network and visual inspection.
criteria.license_notes: Reference used for accessibility acceptance only.
criteria.source: WCAG 2.2 AA as selected by the repository quality bar
criteria.target: Critical routes remain usable with keyboard, visible focus, semantic names, reduced motion, responsive layout, and no critical axe violations.
criteria.validity_notes: Claims are bounded to the checked routes and states.

baseline.actual: Local gates passed previously; current remote same-SHA evidence is not available.

criteria.conditions: Local green checks cannot be upgraded to remote or production evidence.
criteria.evidence_method: Pinned Node/pnpm install, current verify/build/E2E, remote same-SHA workflow, artifact hashes, dependency audit and traceability.
criteria.target: The integrated artifact builds and verifies on the same SHA with traceable artifacts and no secret or dependency gate failure.
criteria.validity_notes: External workflow and deployment authority remain separate gates.

baseline.actual: Local allowlisted logs and in-memory metrics exist; external collector/retention/traces are not proven.

criteria.conditions: No production endpoint or credential may be invented or contacted.
criteria.evidence_method: Collector/metrics/traces/alerts in an authorized isolated environment, failure injection, runbook execution, and redaction inspection.
criteria.source: SPEC observability/runtime contracts and AAA plan
criteria.target: Failures are observable, attributable, alertable, and recoverable without exposing sensitive payloads.
criteria.validity_notes: In-memory instrumentation alone does not prove operations.

baseline.actual: Historical local recovery evidence exists for narrower slices; full AAA recovery bar is not current.

criteria.conditions: No destructive operation against production; unknown production volume remains unknown.
criteria.evidence_method: Runbooks, disposable database/Qdrant, representative synthetic fixtures, checksums/counts, timing, and recovery report.
criteria.source: AAA plan and data migration/recovery rules
criteria.target: Backup, restore, rollback, retry, concurrency, and failure recovery are exercised in an isolated representative environment.
criteria.validity_notes: A backup file or policy statement is not restore evidence.

baseline.actual: B-07/M02 publication and clinical review remain pending.

criteria.conditions: This gate cannot be completed by code or an AI suggestion; it requires human authority.
criteria.evidence_method: Content ledger, item review, preflight, publication/withdrawal audit, human decision record, and public-boundary scan.
criteria.license_notes: No clinical content copied into this manifest.
criteria.source: AGENTS.md clinical governance and B-07 backlog
criteria.target: Every clinically published item and protocol is internally authored, reviewed by the authorized human, preflighted, versioned, and auditable.
criteria.validity_notes: Digital learning evidence is not practical competency evidence.

baseline.actual: Adapters/fakes and derived-index controls exist; full eval suite is not current.

criteria.conditions: No external provider is contacted without explicit authority and configured safe environment.
criteria.evidence_method: Adapter tests, failure injection, Qdrant reconciliation, prompt-injection/PII/groundedness evals, exposure tests, and human approval path.
criteria.target: AI and Qdrant remain server-side, derived, scoped, structured, timeout-bounded, reconstructible, human-reviewed, and non-decisional.
criteria.validity_notes: A successful fake provider test does not prove provider safety.

baseline.actual: No pilot authorization or clinical release gate is current.

criteria.conditions: Do not enroll real participants or expose clinical content without explicit human and operational authority.
criteria.evidence_method: Approved protocol, readiness pack, pilot event log, outcome analysis, incident review, and final audit.
criteria.source: AAA plan pilot gates and PRD metrics
criteria.target: A controlled pilot has approved scope, authority, observability, abort criteria, outcome measures, and an independent exit decision without claiming practical competency.
criteria.validity_notes: This criterion cannot be satisfied by local implementation alone.

goal: Implement and verify the CVG Premium State of the Art Triplo AAA program without weakening clinical, security, data, or evidence gates.
